items.text: Christian McCaffrey (thigh) questionable to return mid-game vs Falcons after early TD and awkward tackle; left to tent/locker. Kaelon Black scored 30yd TD in his absence.
items.why: Thigh issue after first drive; Schefter notes to locker room; 49ers WR-depleted so heavy early usage.
items.implication: Monitor return; if out rest of way, backup RB surge. Bye next week may influence.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, full opportunity to 49ers backup RBs; pregame Levitan tempted CMC slot WR role amid Evans/Deebo OUT.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) officially inactive after being unlikely/GTD-pessimistic; missed three prior games, not full participant.
items.why: Rapoport: unlikely, early return attempt; Schefter confirms inactive alongside Ridley.
items.implication: Jets RB committee shifts fully; primary backup (Allen) becomes RB2/flex with volume vs MIA.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry share to Jets backup RBs; elevated role in positive matchup.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals (ankle/high ankle sprain); Tyler Huntley to start. Was close but downgraded Saturday.
items.why: Downgraded after limited practice; Schefter/Rapoport confirm high-ankle, Huntley starts again.
items.implication: Major QB downgrade for Ravens stack; Huntley streaming option with volume to Flowers/Henry/Andrews.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/carries for Zay Flowers, Derrick Henry, Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely in Ravens offense.

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf) GTD with optimism; Rams feel good he plays vs Raiders if no setbacks. Feeling better Saturday, minor per reports.
items.why: Schefter: optimistic, feeling better; Rapoport confident; pregame workout likely for 4:25 ET kick.
items.implication: If active, elite WR1; if out, major downgrade for Stafford/Rams pass game amid Adams OUT.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if plays; reverse if inactive boosts other Rams WRs/TEs.

items.text: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: Official injury report; Schefter details via McManus.
items.implication: PHI pass game funnels to remaining options; Saquon/Goedert/Hurts elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Dallas Goedert, other Eagles pass-catchers; more checkdowns to Barkley.

items.text: Actives include Vikings RB Jordan Mason, Texans WR Tank Dell (season debut after ~2yrs), Browns RB Dylan Sampson, Bucs QB Baker Mayfield.
items.why: ETR listed IN; Schefter official actives.
items.implication: Mason boosts MIN run game; Dell debut targets in HOU; Mayfield returns under center.
items.opportunity: Mason lead/committee RB snaps; Dell route share debut.

items.text: Saquon Barkley questionable but EXPECTED TO PLAY Monday vs Cowboys; efficient in limited prior games.
items.why: Rapoport/Eagles report: Q but expected; strong MNF matchup vs DAL run D.
items.implication: RB1 if active; volume secure with WRs out.

items.text: Josh Jacobs activated/IN and active for Packers return from exempt list vs Lions.
items.why: Packers activated; Schefter/Rapoport confirm return to field.
items.implication: RB2/flex with workload questions post-layoff; Berry cautious.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries if no limitation; monitor split with backups.
items.conflict: Berry hates post-layoff workload risk vs DET.

items.text: Rico Dowdle is up (active) for Steelers vs Saints per inactives.
items.why: Steelers inactives confirm Dowdle and Elliott up.

items.text: Cam Skattebo expected to resume lead back role for Giants vs Texans; JJ McCarthy long leash.
items.implication: RB2 upside in lead role; Berry hated matchup previously.
items.conflict: Berry HATE tough HOU matchup/prior rank.

items.text: Lamar/Puka/Breece statuses crucial to DFS main slate; projections fully updated on latest news. Sneaky scratches: Brian Robinson, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren etc. Tempted by CMC more slot/WR amid 49ers WR outs despite usual skepticism on RB-as-WR.
items.why: Player-specific: early news hope; rare buy on CMC alignment with Kaelon Black/WR injuries.
items.implication: DFS pivots; Egbuka OUT confirmed sneaky miss for some.
items.opportunity: CMC routes if more WR; backups for scratched RBs/WRs/TEs.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (sneaky scratch per Levitan); also Mike Evans/Deebo Samuel OUT for 49ers, Davante Adams OUT, Rashee Rice OUT, Jeremiyah Love OUT, David Montgomery OUT, Tyler Warren OUT.
items.why: ETR Sunday list + confirmed inactives; Levitan flagged sneaky.
items.implication: Clear paths for backups/handcuffs; 49ers WR void boosts CMC early.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for teammates (e.g. other TB/SF/LAR/KC/ARI/HOU/IND options).

items.text: With Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel OUT, tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot/WR despite rare true RB-as-WR outcomes; Kaelon Black presence noted.
items.why: Dire 49ers WR situation + CMC smile/comment on gameplan; usually skeptic but buying this week.
items.implication: CMC elite even more via receiving; mid-game thigh now risks it.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets/slot snaps for CMC pre-injury.

items.text: Lamar Jackson was close this week, expected back next week (vs Bills context).
items.implication: Hold for ROS; short-term Huntley bridge.

items.text: Posted top 10 overall fantasy rankings for Week 7; live Last Call show covers Jacobs, PHI pass game (post-outs), Jets RBs.
items.why: Actionable top-10 heading into Sunday; show answers start/sit.
items.implication: Use for lineup finalization amid status flux.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown (usage/matchup @CHI) and Tucker Kraft (TE buffet vs DET, Lions allow many TE TDs/fantasy pts).
items.why: Brown real role/volume; Kraft vs Lions TE-friendly D (9 TE TDs in 5 games).
items.implication: Strong WR/TE starts; top ranks actionable.
items.opportunity: High target/route/red-zone share in good matchups.

items.text: LOVE volume RBs Jaylen Warren (@NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@CAR) for big workloads in friendly matchups. Saquon if active (efficient, good DAL matchup). Coleman should be 100% rostered (Broncos RB to own).
items.why: Workloads + carved-up run Ds; Coleman IR return upside over Dobbins/Harvey inefficiency.

items.text: HATE Rome Odunze (shadowed by Gonzalez, outside targets), Josh Downs (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (tough SEA D), Josh Jacobs (post-layoff workload questions @DET).
items.why: Nasty matchups/roles; Jacobs layoff risk despite activation.
items.implication: Sit/fade in rankings; live show discusses Jacobs/PHI/Jets.
items.conflict: Jacobs ACTIVE but Berry remains down on immediate role.
